messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
The viscous friction force depends on angular velocity, damping coefficient, fluid viscosity, and contact area.
area shape and size influence the pivot.
pivot damping should be taken into account when the physical pendulum moves through a viscous medium.
medium resistance matters in the case of slow motion, heavy fluids, or lubricated joints.
joints with oil or dense air produce a torque proportional to angular velocity.
